faq.title: CS2 Crosshair FAQ: Import Codes & Pro Stats | ClutchCrosshair
faq.description: How to import a CS2 crosshair code, why old CSGO- codes don't work anymore, and which crosshair CS2 pros use the most, with live stats.
faq.intro: Everything about CS2 crosshair codes: how to import them, the new CS2 format, and what the pros use. Stats updated on {date}.
items: How do I import a crosshair code in CS2?
Copy the share code, then in CS2 open Settings › Game › Crosshair, click Share or Import and paste the code. The crosshair is applied right away.
How do I use console commands instead of a share code?
Open the CS2 console with the ~ key (enable the developer console in Settings › Game if needed), paste the console commands copied from ClutchCrosshair and press Enter.
Why don't old CSGO- crosshair codes work anymore?

Since the CS2 update of September 30, 2026, crosshair share codes use a new format starting with CS (without dashes), and sizes are stored in pixels. Old CSGO-xxxxx codes can no longer be imported. Every code on ClutchCrosshair uses the new CS2 format.
Where do these pro crosshair codes come from?
They are read directly from official CS2 match demos. Each code is the exact crosshair the player used in that match, and the date shown is the date of the match.
How often are the crosshairs updated?
Every time we read a new official match demo of a team, the crosshairs of its players are checked and updated. The "Last update" date shows the most recent match where the crosshair was confirmed.
What is the most used crosshair by CS2 pros?

Based on the {total} pro crosshairs on ClutchCrosshair, the most used colors are {families}. {smallGap} of pros use a gap of 1 or less, {dot} use a center dot and {outline} use an outline. Most pros play with a small static crosshair.
What is the best CS2 crosshair?

There is no single best crosshair: it should be easy to see on every map and not hide the enemy's head. A good start is to copy the crosshair of a pro you like, then adjust the color and the size to your screen.
Why does a crosshair look different in my game?
In CS2, crosshair sizes are in pixels for a given screen height. If you play in a different resolution (for example 4:3 stretched) the crosshair can look slightly bigger or smaller than for the pro.
How do I share my own CS2 crosshair?
In CS2, open Settings › Game › Crosshair and click Share or Import, then copy your code. Anyone can import it with the same button.
A crosshair is wrong or missing. How can I report it?
Email us at {email} or use the Contact us button on the home page. We check every report against the latest official match demos.

faq: Is this CS2 crosshair generator free?
Yes. It is free, with no sign-up and no download. Everything runs in your browser.
How do I put my new crosshair in CS2?

Click Copy next to your share code, then in CS2 open Settings › Game › Crosshair, click Share or Import and paste the code. You can also copy the console commands and paste them in the CS2 console (~).
Why does my crosshair look different in 4:3 stretched?

In 4:3 stretched (1280×960, 1024×768...) or 5:4 stretched (1280×1024), the game image is stretched to fill a 16:9 screen, so the crosshair gets wider: horizontal lines look longer and vertical lines thicker. Pick your resolution under the preview (16:9, 4:3, 16:10 or 5:4) to see exactly how your crosshair will look in game. Your crosshair code stays the same.
Can I start from a pro player's crosshair?
Yes. Pick a pro in the Start from list, or paste any CS2 crosshair code, then change the color, size or gap. The new code updates instantly.
Does it work with old CSGO- crosshair codes?
No. Since the CS2 update of September 30, 2026, only the new codes starting with CS can be imported in the game. The generator only creates new CS2 codes.

hubFaq: How do I open the console in CS2?
Go to Settings › Game and set Enable Developer Console to Yes. Then press the ~ key (under Escape) in game to open it. If your keyboard has no ~ key, bind toggleconsole to another key.
Do console commands work in competitive matchmaking?

Most commands that change your own settings (crosshair, HUD, radar, mouse, audio) work everywhere. Commands marked Needs sv_cheats, and server commands starting with mp_ or bot_, only work on a server you host, for example a private match with bots.
How do I save my console commands?
Put them in a file named autoexec.cfg in the game's cfg folder (game/csgo/cfg) and add +exec autoexec to your launch options, or type exec autoexec in the console.
Why does a CS:GO command not work in CS2?
Many CS:GO commands were removed or renamed in CS2, such as net_graph. Commands marked Removed in CS2 on this page tell you what to use instead.

faq: How do I make a bind in CS2?
Open the console (~) and type bind followed by the key and the command between quotes, for example bind "kp_end" "buy ak47; buy m4a1". The ClutchCrosshair bind generator writes the line for you.
Do buy binds still work in CS2?
Yes. Buy commands such as buy ak47 or buy vesthelm work in CS2. They buy the weapon equipped in that slot of your loadout, so buy m4a1 gives you the M4A1-S if that is the one you equipped.
How do I remove a bind in CS2?
Type unbind followed by the key in the console, for example unbind kp_end.
How do I save my CS2 binds?

Binds you type in the console are saved automatically. To keep a full list safe, put your binds in an autoexec.cfg file in game/csgo/cfg and add +exec autoexec to your launch options. The generator can download that file for you.
What is a jump throw bind?
A bind that jumps and releases your grenade at the same moment, so you throw the same lineup every time. Hold the grenade with the attack button pressed, then press your jump throw key.

method.title: How We Get CS2 Pro Crosshair Codes | ClutchCrosshair
method.description: Every pro crosshair code on ClutchCrosshair is read from an official CS2 match demo, never typed by hand. Here is how codes are collected, dated and checked.
method.h1: How we get the crosshair codes
method.intro: ClutchCrosshair lists the CS2 crosshairs of {pros} pro players from {teams} teams and {creators} content creators. Most recent match read: {date}. Here is exactly where every code comes from.
sections: Pro players: read from official match demos

Every pro crosshair comes from the demo (the replay file) of an official match, downloaded from HLTV. A demo records the settings of every player, including the exact crosshair share code. We read it with a small program: no code is ever typed by hand. One map is enough, because a player keeps the same crosshair for the whole match.
The date is the date of the match

The date shown next to each pro is the date of the match the code was read from. When a newer match shows the same code, the date moves forward: the crosshair is confirmed. An older demo never replaces a more recent code. Players are followed by their Steam ID, so a transfer to another team is picked up automatically.
Only CS2 codes

Since the CS2 update of 30 September 2026, crosshair share codes use the new CS… format, and old CSGO- codes can no longer be imported in the game. That is why only demos played after that date are read, and no CSGO- code is ever published.
Content creators
Content creators' codes come from their recent FACEIT matches (the copy button on the match page) and are checked about once a month. Their date is the date of the last check.
Every code is checked

Before it is published, each code is decoded to make sure it is a valid CS2 crosshair code. The console commands and the real-size preview are generated from that decoded code, not written by hand. Several pros share exactly the same code: that is normal, because a crosshair has few possible settings in pixels, and each page lists the pros who share it.
Pro skins and prices

Skins come from the public Steam inventory of each pro, refreshed every day. Prices are the lowest current listing on CSFloat, converted to euros with the daily rate of the European Central Bank. Doppler phases are not priced separately.
Found a wrong code?
Email us at {email}. Every report is checked against the latest official match demos.
